tags.bug: Small adjustments to scenario text to fix translation errors.

During certain conditions the UI of the HP bar was not displayed correctly.
This has been corrected.

Increases to the HP of the character which can be achieved  
through acquiring passive skills  in the skill tree were not reflected correctly.
This has been corrected.
